native_model: research.pef07.pef07.Looper: 32D, shared residual block, 12 chronological recurrent visits, original final 2-logit head
aux_model: single shared torch.nn.Linear(32,2) head applied at recurrent visits after 2nd,3rd,4th,5th focal input
seed_formula: SHA256(NEC04F/paired-native-initial-seed/v1| + original NEC04A calibration root seed), 1 + first8 big endian mod (2^31-2)
main_loss: cross_entropy(native original composed teacher output at 12th recurrent visit)
auxiliary_stage_loss: mean of four cross_entropy(auxiliary head at exact kth focal arrival for k=2,3,4,5)
aux_shuffled_label_domain: NEC04F/balanced-shuffled-source-aux-label/v1| + root_seed + context_group + stage_k + mask: take 16 smallest SHA256 ranks as class1, others class0
aux_prefix_labels: XOR of first k original focal bits in ascending chronological position, verified with independent scalar oracle
training_validation_access: all 3 arm 240/900 native+aux model and optimizer SHA256 checkpoints sealed before any owned-calibration-validation labels accessed
primary_endpoint: mean over six original calibration roots of (aux_prefix minus aux_shuffled) native original composed-label accuracy on selector=1 owned validation examples at 900 updates
secondary_endpoint: native full task accuracy, k2/k3/k4/k5 true intermediate XOR auxiliary accuracy, recurrent hidden parity and full 5th-order output Walsh energy; 240-step diagnostic and vanilla arm
